pageBuilder.heading: Work at Uriah Child Care in Vineland
pageBuilder.subheading: A small, family-run center in Vineland. If you love caring for young children, we'd like to hear from you.

pageBuilder.heading: Apply online
pageBuilder.intro: Tell us a little about yourself and attach your résumé. It takes about five minutes. Ms. Paulette or Tameca will reach out if there is a good fit.
pageBuilder.successMessage: Thank you for applying. We read every application, and we will call or email you if there is a good fit.

seo.metaDescription: Apply to work at Uriah Child Care, a licensed child care center in Vineland, NJ. Fill out a short application and upload your résumé and cover letter.
